cities.name: Zagreb

interests.name: History & Upper Town 🏛️
interests.description: Medieval alleys, old squares and the iconic St. Mark’s Church.

interests.name: Parks & Green Spaces 🌳
interests.description: Zrinjevac, the Green Horseshoe, leafy promenades and elegant 19th-century park architecture.

interests.name: Urban Culture & Street Life 🎨
interests.description: Creative museums, lively café streets and artistic corners.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Zagreb’s classics such as warm štrukli, hearty soups, roasted turkey with mlinci and bakery pastries. Comforting, local and full of home-style flavors.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Upper Town: Wander medieval lanes and peaceful corners. → ⛪ St. Mark’s Square: Famous colorful tiled roof. → ⛪ Zagreb Cathedral: Impressive Gothic towers. → ☕ Coffee in Tkalča Street. Afternoon: 🌳 Stroll through the Green Horseshoe including Zrinjevac. → 🎭 Visit the Museum of Broken Relationships. → 🍽️ Lunch: Try štrukli, soups, roasted turkey with mlinci or vegetarian plates. Sunset: 🌅 Jarun Lake or Bundek Park. Night: 🌃 Cozy evening walk through the center — dessert cafés, lights and street performers.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms around Cvjetni Square and Zrinjevac.
🌳 Maksimir Park: Lakes and bright spring greenery.
☕ Sunny café terraces throughout the city center.
🌞 Breezy afternoons by Jarun or Bundek lakes.
🍦 Ice cream under Zrinjevac trees.
🌅 Upper Town sunset points overlooking red rooftops.
🍁 Golden leaves in Maksimir and the Green Horseshoe.
🎨 Museum visits for cozy afternoons.
🥐 Seasonal pastries and warm drinks.
🎄 Tomislav Square ice rink and festive stalls.
✨ Magical light displays in Zrinjevac.
☕ Hot drinks in traditional cafés.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚋 Trams cover the entire center and run frequently.
🚶 Upper Town is best explored on foot because of narrow historic streets.
🚌 Buses connect lakes, outer neighborhoods and Maksimir.
📱 Use the official ZET app for tram arrivals and navigation.

places.name: Zrinjevac Park

places.name: Museum of Broken Relationships

hidden_gems.name: Mirogoj Arcades
hidden_gems.description: Green domes and ivy-covered arches — one of Europe's most beautiful cemeteries.

cities.name: Split

interests.name: Roman Heritage 🏛️
interests.description: Explore ancient palace walls, Peristyle Square and maze-like stone alleys dating back to Roman times.

interests.name: Sea Views & Promenades 🌊
interests.description: Blue horizons, breezy walkways and charming harbor scenes along the Adriatic.

interests.name: Mediterranean Culture 🌿
interests.description: Warm coastal life, lively cafés, local markets and Dalmatian vibes at every corner.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Dalmatian classics like pašticada, grilled fish, mussels in buzara sauce, seafood risotto and light Mediterranean veggie plates — fresh and aromatic.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Diocletian’s Palace: Explore Roman walls, Peristyle Square and maze-like stone alleys. → ⛪ St. Domnius Cathedral & Bell Tower: Climb for incredible panoramic views. → ☕ Coffee on the Riva Promenade: Palm trees and sea breeze. Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town Wander: Marble alleys, artisan shops and charming squares. → 🍽️ Lunch: Seafood dishes, pašticada, grilled fish or veggie plates. Sunset: 🌅 Marjan Hill Viewpoint: Legendary golden-hour views over the Adriatic. Night: 🌃 Riva Evening Walk: Soft lights, gelato stands and a calm seaside atmosphere.

ideas: 🌿 Forest paths and viewpoints on Marjan Hill.
🌸 Blooming Old Town courtyards.
☕ Sunny Riva terraces with sea breeze.
🏖️ Swimming at Bačvice Beach or Kašjuni.
🍦 Gelato in palace alleyways.
🌅 Vidilica sunset views on Marjan.
🍁 Cooler Marjan hikes.
🐟 Warm seafood meals in cozy konobas.
🎭 Museums and cultural spots with fewer crowds.
🎄 Riva Christmas stalls and live music.
✨ Festive lights in Pjaca and Old Town streets.
☕ Warm drinks with sea views.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚶 The palace complex and Old Town are best explored on foot.
🚌 Local buses connect beaches, viewpoints, Marjan and outer districts.
🚕 Taxis and ride apps are widely available near the Riva promenade.
⛴️ Ferries and catamarans to nearby islands depart from the main port next to Old Town.
📱 Use Google Maps or local transit apps for real-time bus departures.

city_events.name: Sudamja Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Cultural celebrations dedicated to Split’s patron saint with parades, music and traditional events.

city_events.name: Ultra Europe
city_events.description: 🎶 One of Europe’s biggest open-air electronic music festivals in Split.

city_events.name: Days of Diocletian

city_events.name: Split Advent
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive seaside markets, concerts and cozy winter vibes with lights along the Riva.

places.name: Marjan Hill Viewpoint
places.description: Scenic viewpoint over Split and the Adriatic — great for sunsets.

places.name: Bačvice Beach
places.description: Popular urban beach with sandy areas and shallow waters — perfect for summer dips.

hidden_gems.description: Whimsical and unusual collection of frog dioramas — quirky and fun.

hidden_gems.name: Medulić Gallery Terrace

cities.name: Dubrovnik

interests.name: City Walls & Fortresses 🧱
interests.description: Panoramic walks along medieval walls with iconic Adriatic views.

interests.name: Sea Views 🌊
interests.description: Deep blue horizons, coastal cliffs and dramatic island scenery.

interests.name: Medieval Old Town 🏰
interests.description: Marble streets, arches, towers and centuries of history.

cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy seafood risotto, mussels, grilled fish, buzara dishes and Mediterranean vegetarian plates — fresh and perfect for coastal evenings.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🧱 City Walls: Gorgeous morning light and fewer crowds. → 🏰 Old Town: Marble streets and picturesque squares. → ☕ Coffee on Stradun. Afternoon: 🏝️ Lokrum Island: Pine forests, cliffs, wildlife and swimming spots. → 🍽️ Lunch: Seafood plates, mussels or light Mediterranean dishes. Sunset: 🌅 Fort Lovrijenac: Dramatic sunset over the sea and stone walls. Night: 🌃 Stradun Evening Walk: Soft lights, gelato and relaxing coastal atmosphere.

ideas: 🌸 Quiet Old Town mornings before peak season.
🌊 Clear Adriatic views and fresh sea breeze.
🌿 Lokrum greenery returning after winter.
🏖️ Swimming at Banje Beach.
🏝️ Island trips and boat tours.
🌅 Sunset viewpoints from fortresses and coastal promenades.
🍁 Warm golden tones across medieval alleys.
🥘 Comforting Dalmatian meals in cozy konobas.
🎭 Cultural programs, art exhibitions and concerts.
🎄 Old Town Advent market.
✨ Stradun glowing under festive lights.
☕ Warm drinks in quiet historic streets.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚶 Old Town is fully pedestrian — walking is essential.
🚌 Local buses connect outer districts with Pile Gate, the main Old Town entrance.
⛴️ Lokrum boats run every 30 minutes in season from the Old Port.
🚡 Take the cable car to Srđ Hill for spectacular views.
📱 Use Google Maps or Libertas bus info for schedules and routes.

city_events.name: Advent in Dubrovnik

cities.name: Vukovar

interests.name: History & Heritage 🏛️
interests.description: Museums, baroque manor houses and important historical landmarks.

interests.name: Danube Scenery 🌊
interests.description: Wide riverside horizons, peaceful walking paths and calm reflections.

interests.name: Museums & Reflection 🕊️
interests.description: Meaningful places dedicated to remembrance, education and history.

cities.local_food_tip: Slavonian dishes such as čobanac, fiš paprikaš, river fish, hearty soups and rustic pastries — warm, flavorful and authentic.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🕊️ Memorial Center of Homeland War: A meaningful and educational start. → 🏛️ Eltz Manor: Elegant baroque museum by the river. → ☕ Riverside coffee along the Danube. Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: Peaceful riverside walk with long views. → 🍽️ Lunch: Slavonian stews, river fish or warm vegetarian soups. Sunset: 🌅 Wide Danube horizon glowing in golden light. Night: 🌃 Quiet center walk under soft street lighting.

🌸 Blossoms in local parks.
☕ Sunny Danube-side terraces.
🌊 Cooling breezes along the promenade.
🍦 Ice cream in the town center.

🍁 Golden foliage along the Danube.
🏛️ Museum visits on cooler days.
🥘 Comforting traditional meals.
🎄 Riverbank Advent stalls.
✨ Town center festive lights.
☕ Warm drinks in cozy cafés.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚶 Most key sites lie along the Danube and are walkable.
🚌 Local buses connect neighborhoods and outer zones of Vukovar.
🚗 Taxis are affordable and practical for longer distances.
📍 Use the river promenade as the main orientation point.

cities.name: Ilok

interests.name: Wine Culture 🍇
interests.description: Historic wine cellars, vineyard slopes and centuries-old traditions.

interests.name: Castle Views 🏰
interests.description: Hilltop panoramas over vineyards and the Danube basin.

interests.name: Danube Scenery 🌊
interests.description: Calm riverside paths and wide, peaceful horizons.

cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy hearty Slavonian dishes, river fish specialties, dumpling soups and rustic comfort meals — perfect with Ilok’s regional cuisine.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Ilok Castle: Hilltop panoramas over vineyards and the Danube. → 🍇 Medieval Wine Cellars (Iločki podrumi): Historic stone corridors and traditional barrels; tours can be enjoyed even without alcohol. → ☕ Coffee on a terrace overlooking hills. Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: Quiet riverside walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: Slavonian stews, river fish dishes or warm vegetarian soups. Sunset: 🌅 Fiery sunsets over vineyards and the river. Night: 🌃 Peaceful old-town stroll under soft lights.

ideas: 🌸 Early vineyard blossoms across the hills.
🌳 Riverside morning walks in mild weather.
☀️ Clear castle viewpoints in soft spring light.
🍇 Vineyard estate walks and scenic slopes.
🌊 Refreshing river breeze on warm afternoons.
🌅 Dramatic sunsets over the Danube and vineyards.
🍁 Golden grape-harvest landscapes.
🥘 Warm traditional meals after walks.
🏰 Castle framed by deep autumn colors.
🎄 Castle-hill Advent programs.
✨ Quiet winter panoramas over the river.
☕ Warm drinks with a hilltop view.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚶 Ilok is compact and easy to explore on foot.
🚗 Local taxis are best for reaching vineyards and estates outside town.
📍 Use the castle hill as the main orientation point.
🚌 Regional buses connect Ilok with Vukovar and Osijek.
